remarks: What if you could have the privacy and tranquility of an artist's nature retreat without giving up space, convenience to Westport, Norwalk and Wilton, great commuting, and everyday amenities? Located in the highly desirable Cranbury neighborhood, this exceptional light-filled 5BR Colonial offers exactly that. A dramatic two-story foyer welcomes you into beautifully designed living spaces featuring newly refinished hardwood floors, elegant dining room with coffered ceiling, bay-windowed living room with fireplace. Just off the kitchen, the stunning family room features a soaring vaulted ceiling, wood-burning fireplace and sliding doors to the deck-creating a seamless connection to nature and effortless indoor-outdoor living. The spacious kitchen includes double ovens, center island, and walk-in pantry/mudroom just a few steps up from the garage. A main-level office makes working from home a pleasure. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite includes a large bath, walk-in closet/laundry, and a flexible adjoining room perfect for a second office, nursery or 2nd walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths complete the upper level. The bright, beautifully finished lower level with full bath and 5th bedroom offers incredible versatility for guests, recreation, fitness, or play and was an artist's studio for this seller. Surrounded by privacy and the peaceful sounds of nature, this is a home designed to enjoy, entertain, and truly live in.
